priya_content: ```
1/ We benchmarked latency & per-token cost across open models and setups. The headline surprised us.
2/ Serving choices often change unit economics more than model choice.

4/ Join our Apr 12 webinar for full benchmarks + playbooks: https://redwood.ai/bench?utm_campaign=bench-apr12&utm_source=x&utm_medium=social
```
